newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADE Corp cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADE Corp cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown analyst Byron Walker confirmed he downgraded ADE Corp to neutral from buy.
-- Walker said rating action was based on indications that demand in wafer market served by company may be softening.

-- Walker said he took no action on earnings estimates for now because of company's large existing backlog. "At this point we're taking a more cautionary stance on the company's ability to meet or beat estimates."
